sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.subtitle: Everything you need to know about mock tests, multi-attempt certification, and partner interview routing.

items.question: What does the ₹5,000 CareerLoop Pro fee cover?
items.answer: The ₹5,000 fee is strictly for our CareerLoop Pro Program, which includes unlimited structured mock tests, multiple proctored final test attempts (with automatic best-score selection), skill preparation modules, and certified candidate dossier generation. Interview routing and placement assistance are provided as complimentary value-added benefits.

items.question: Can I take the final test multiple times?
items.answer: Yes! CareerLoop Pro allows multiple proctored final test attempts. Our platform automatically records and selects your highest score to build your certified candidate dossier for employer review.

items.question: Is there a free way to test my baseline skills first?
items.answer: Yes, you can register and take your initial baseline assessment for free to check your starting score before deciding to upgrade to the full CareerLoop Pro mock test and certification package.

items.question: What bus transportation and canteen facilities are available?
items.answer: Many partner industrial and enterprise facilities provide designated bus commute routes and subsidized on-site canteen meals during shifts. Exact workplace amenities depend on the specific hiring organization and location.

items.question: Are jobs guaranteed with the ₹5,000 program?
items.answer: No private platform can legally guarantee employment. The ₹5,000 fee guarantees the delivery of our mock test preparation, proctored testing, best-score certification, and active profile routing to our 450+ partner HR agencies. Final hiring selections and job offers are determined entirely by the hiring employers based on candidate performance during interviews.
